title: nan
authors: Orjales F.; Losada-Pita J.; Paz-Lopez A.; Deibe A.
key_contribution: Presents a positioning system combining UWB-based global location with unidirectional laser rangefinders for precise UAV missions near walls in GPS-denied metallic environments.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
